definitions.explanation: A surface that is tilted at an angle rather than being flat or vertical. Used for natural terrain such as mountainsides and hills, as well as man-made inclines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な{斜面|しゃめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}った→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{斜面|しゃめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦スキー→スキー：03849_sukii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{滑|すべ}り{降|お}りた→滑り降りる：29571_suberioriru⟧。
examples.english: I skied down the snowy slope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{斜面|しゃめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れ→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧になった。
examples.english: The slope collapsed due to heavy rain, and the road was closed to traffic.

notes:
USAGE:
A factual, somewhat technical term commonly used in geography, construction, disaster reporting, and skiing contexts. Frequently modified by ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な (steep) or ⟦{緩|ゆる}やか→緩やか：13813_yuruyaka⟧な (gentle).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な{斜面|しゃめん}: steep slope
- ⟦{緩|ゆる}やか→緩やか：13813_yuruyaka⟧な{斜面|しゃめん}: gentle slope
- {斜面|しゃめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧: the slope collapses (landslide)
- {斜面|しゃめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb a slope

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{坂|さか}→坂：01415_saka⟧: hill, slope (everyday word, usually refers to roads)
- ⟦{傾斜|けいしゃ}→傾斜：05447_keisha⟧: inclination, gradient (more technical/abstract)
